title: Canonical-Path Cellar Automaton With Deferred Autocorrelation Debt
novelty_claim: Interpret `cellar automata` literally as a pushdown or prefix-debt automaton over canonical orbit words for the exact `167/80` cyclic obstruction behind order `668`, not as another flat cellular rule on raw support bits.
closest_prior_art: Constantine and Constantine (2025) on the exact `167/80` cyclic obstruction
Bright, Kotsireas, and Ganesh (2018) and related SAT+CAS exact-search work as the main collapse risk
CA design and bent-function search literature as the nearest automata-side context
differentiation: The state is a canonical path or run-length prefix plus deferred debt, not a raw support bitmap or an `s`-flip defect field.
The branch stays pinned to the exact obstruction already known to matter for order `668`, so it does not make a broad `CA for Hadamard search` claim.
The method only survives if stack-carried debt beats a non-automaton prefix search on the same tokenization, same exact-completion oracle, and same equivalence accounting.
easiest_falsifier: Run a non-automaton prefix search on the same canonical tokenization and the same exact-completion oracle budget. If the automaton drops any solved same-template witness prefix or fails to improve frontier reduction or certificate rate under that matched baseline, kill it.
evidence_plan: Lock one canonical support encoding for weight-`80` subsets of `Z_167` and define the deferred-debt state fields explicitly.
Validate zero false negatives on one solved same-template positive control under the same exact verifier and equivalence accounting used elsewhere in the repo.
Benchmark witness retention, oracle calls, and frontier reduction against a non-automaton prefix search on the same representation before any real `167/80` scale-up.
budget_envelope: Highest reserve budget, but phase-gated: spend only on representation lock, positive control, and matched comparator design first; no wide `167` or `668` search unless the control packet passes cleanly.

title: Proof-Carrying Cellar Frontier With Online Exact-Feedback Motifs
novelty_claim: Keep the canonical-path cellar frontier, but convert failed exact completions into short reusable local motifs or transition vetoes so the automaton learns from proof artifacts instead of remaining a static filter.
closest_prior_art: Bright, Kotsireas, and Ganesh (2018) and related SAT+CAS / programmatic-SAT lines for structured Hadamard-family search
The static `autocorrelation_debt_pushdown` reserve branch as the immediate internal precursor
Clause-learning exact-search work that already handles conflicts globally
differentiation: The claimed mechanism is reusable local exact-feedback on top of the cellar frontier, not generic clause learning or a hidden exact-search oracle.
The comparison stays on the same canonical representation and the same completion oracle as the static pushdown baseline.
The branch is promoted only if exact failures compress into short local guards that transfer across starts of the same template.
easiest_falsifier: Compare against a static pushdown filter with the same canonical representation and the same completion oracle. If the learned feedback is global, one-off, or lowers solver calls only by dropping witness retention, kill it.
evidence_plan: Start only after the static pushdown branch clears the solved-control and matched-baseline gates.
Instrument failed exact completions as candidate local motifs or transition vetoes while holding the canonical representation fixed.
Measure witness retention, exact-oracle calls, and end-to-end throughput against the static pushdown baseline on held-out same-template controls.
budget_envelope: Secondary and contingent budget only: small held-out control budget after the champion survives; stop immediately if feedback does not stay local and reusable.

title: Liability-Field Convolution Slice Search On The Exact `167/80` Target
novelty_claim: Change the H1-side state from raw support bits to local convolution liabilities so search acts on an auditable field of cyclic debt rather than on the bitmap directly.
closest_prior_art: Constantine and Constantine (2025) on the exact `167/80` target
The repo's retired `H1` support-space CA as the nearest collapse risk
CA design and local-repair heuristics that already move defects without changing the search channel
differentiation: The state is a liability field tied to the exact cyclic obstruction, not a repackaged raw support search.
The branch remains reserve-only unless a same-representation non-CA liability search is defined up front.
Any gain must appear in exact-hit, closest-target, or orbit-coverage endpoints rather than in liability scores alone.
easiest_falsifier: Run a same-representation non-CA liability search with identical liability tables, oracle budget, and verifier. If the apparent gain disappears or only surrogate liabilities improve, kill it.
evidence_plan: Define the liability-field representation and its exact relation to the `167/80` verifier.
Build one solved same-template positive control and one same-representation non-CA comparator before any scale-up.
Promote only if exact endpoints improve beyond what representation change alone already gives.
budget_envelope: Tertiary reserve budget only: one representation audit plus one matched control/baseline packet; no broad spend unless it proves more than a relabeling of `H1`.
